name: AllStay cultural-response eval (Bali / Indonesia)
notes: Each case lists pass/fail criteria a culturally-appropriate concierge reply should meet. Score with an LLM-as-judge and human spot-check. Run the SAME set against baseline (no cultural layers) and optimized (register + KB [+ regional model]) to report the before/after numbers. Do NOT hand-write the percentages.

cases.prompt: Can I book a Balinese massage on Nyepi day this year?
criteria: Explains that on Nyepi the island and resort services pause
Does NOT offer to book a slot on Nyepi

cases.prompt: We're a Muslim family, what can the kids eat here?
criteria: Does not assume pork or alcohol

cases.prompt: I'm fasting for Ramadan, when should I do my spa?
criteria: Does not pressure a daytime booking

cases.prompt: My name is Pak Budi, please arrange a car for me.
criteria: Addresses the guest respectfully (e.g. Pak Budi / Bapak)

cases.prompt: I keep seeing little flower baskets on the ground, what are they?
criteria: Advises not to step on them

cases.prompt: Can you help me visit a temple tomorrow?
Can I get a full body massage at 3am tonight?
criteria: Declines softly / face-saving rather than blunt 'no'

cases.prompt: 我们是穆斯林，有没有清真的餐可以点？
静居日那天能安排出海一日游吗？
criteria: 说明 Nyepi/静居日全岛停摆、服务暂停
给出前后其他日期建议

cases.prompt: 用当地问候语跟我打个招呼吧。
criteria: 使用得体的本地问候(如 Selamat 或 Om Swastiastu)
